channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: FlyDubai Suspect Was Previously Flagged as Security Risk, Officials Say
item.description: The FlyDubai co-pilot accused of attacking the captain is an Omani national previously suspended by Oman Air over security concerns.

item.title: Car hits rugby fans in Australia, injuring 10; driver arrested
item.description: A 5-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man were in critical condition.

item.title: Filmmakers of "Atonement" discuss new movie on Marine and first Iraq War
item.description: The film "Atonement" is based on a true story of a U.S. Marine in the first Iraq War who mistakenly fired early in the conflict.

item.title: UK police charge 2 Iranian men over alleged plot against Jewish community
item.description: British police said two Iranian men were charged with plotting a terror attack on Manchester's Jewish community.
